source.label: Tekken Tag Tournament move and combo archive
source.note: Frame results are listed per hit, KD means knockdown and means not applicable. Damage figures are guide-reported and depend on the stated conditions. Recovery setups are escapable. Selected archive coverage, routes have not been independently tested in-game. Startup counts begin after command entry. Stagger advantage does not equal guaranteed time unable to block.

mechanics.title: Tagging
mechanics.text: 5 tags out; 2+5 attempts a tag throw. Buffer 5 after a tag-capable launcher connects. A blocked or missed launcher does not trigger the juggle tag.

mechanics.title: Tag classes
mechanics.text: Class 1 gives the most follow-up freedom; class 2 supports high attacks; class 3 needs low-reaching attacks; class 4 prevents a tech roll; class 5 generally has no guaranteed follow-up. Class is a starting point, not a promise that any partner’s combo will connect.

mechanics.title: Incoming movement
mechanics.text: Cancel the incoming run with u/b,b. For a fast sidestep cancel use d,d/f,f,u/f toward the background or u,u/f,f,d/f toward the foreground. Tap f afterward if you need a standing attack instead of a sidestep attack.

mechanics.title: Devil and Kazuya
mechanics.text: This team normally morphs on screen instead of running in. Its usual grounded, stun, juggle and throw tags are unavailable.

mechanics.title: Crouch cancel and instant rising
mechanics.text: To cancel crouching recovery, time u or f,f at the end of recovery. For a quick while-rising attack, use d~d/b,n plus the attack button, or d~d/f,n plus the button.
